# A day that fails at the source stops the item with a text that says a plain resume replays the stop and names the steps that start the item again: resume, then cancel, then run.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

pipeinit
pipefakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env PIPE_DIR=$WORK/pl
env PIPE_HOME=$WORK/pipe

exec beehestreal item add pipeline day-3 --title 'April 3' --body-file day3.json
! exec beehestreal run day-3 pipeline --workflow pl/partition.star
stderr 'REFUSE: '
stderr 'Fix the cause\. A plain beehest resume replays this stop\. To start the item again, run beehest resume day-3, then beehest cancel day-3, then beehest run day-3\.'

{"day":"2026-04-03"}
